housing: Tunbridge Wells is a spa town with a large stock of Regency and Victorian villas and terraces, many converted into flats, and a private renting share matching the South East average. Many tenants commute to London from Tunbridge Wells and Paddock Wood stations. The rural east of the borough has Wealden weatherboarded and timber-framed houses, oast houses and listed cottages. Paddock Wood is growing with large new-build estates.
checkinTips: Regency and Victorian flat conversions in the town centre: note shared hallways, fire doors, meter cupboards and keys for each door.
Period homes: photograph sash windows, cornicing, fireplaces and any damp in basements or lower ground floors.
Weatherboarded and timber-framed houses in Cranbrook and Hawkhurst: check the boarding, beams and any rot or insect damage.
Rural homes off the gas grid: record the oil tank or LPG supply, fuel level and boiler service label.
Homes near the Medway and its streams in Paddock Wood: check ground floors and walls for damp or past flood marks.
tenantHelp: Private tenants can contact Tunbridge Wells Borough Council's Private Sector Housing team about disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions, and its 'Advice for tenants' page.
